role: Domestic broadband and MVNO wireless platform; NBCUniversal/Peacock/content/theme parks and Sky presently remain economic claims of current shareholders

decision: Advance to DCF; unconfirmed research candidate after valuation
reason: Weighted fair value31.24 versus26.115, but probability shift10pp fromupside todownside removesheadroom and combined adverse assumptions yield15.12 underpersistentreplacementfloor. Long-term conversion/retention economics and local competitor overlap unresolved.

role: Spectrum cable broadband, mobile and video operator investing in network upgrades and rural expansion
mechanism: Network expansion and cheaper upgrades could offset cable churn; completion of upgrade investment might release free cash flow, but leverage directs much cash to lenders.
investigation: Q2 EBITDA5.4bn down4.3%; capital plan11.4bn for2026 excluding previously announced Cox transaction; debt principal93.8bn against509m cash; Q2 FCF969m. Inspected current results and financing rather than infer value from EPS uplift.
decision: Do not advance in this pass; unconfirmed alternative
reason: Very low share price may offer upside, but Cox perimeter/financing and93.8bn debt create a distinct combined-claims modeling requirement; existing evidence cannot establish enough downside resilience to prioritize over Comcast. This is a risk/evidence rejection, not a claim that intrinsic value is below price.

investigation: 38.6m fiber locations atJune, management >60m2030; Q2fiber additions367k/fixed-wireless279k; capital investment plan23-24bn annually2026-28, FCF18bn+2026;42.5% advanced-home-internet households also takewireless.
decision: Do not advance in this pass; credible further-research alternative
reason: At25.625, roughly11.1x2026 adjusted EPS midpoint2.30, growth is not obviously prohibitively priced. However Lumen acquired-perimeter/JV assets and EchoStar financing/copper closure make a full debt/SOTP bridge necessary. Investigated chiefly as funded competing supply to Comcast; no intrinsic valuation conclusion asserted.
